01About

RoadVanta Engineering delivers practical road infrastructure with a focus on quality, control and dependable completion.

From earthworks and pavement layers to asphalt surfacing and rehabilitation, we manage the work from site preparation through completion — with clear coordination at every stage.

  • ARoad Construction
  • BAsphalt Paving
  • CRoad Rehabilitation
  • DEarthwork
  • EInfrastructure Development
02Services

What we build

From ground preparation to finished pavement, our teams handle the work as one coordinated build.

End-to-end road construction, from earthworks and pavement preparation to asphalt surfacing and finishing.

Asphalt paving and road carpeting delivered with controlled placement, grading and compaction.

Base and sub-base preparation, grading and compaction for a stable pavement structure.

Repairs, resurfacing and rehabilitation to restore existing road performance.

Excavation, filling, grading and site preparation for road and infrastructure works.

Asphalt mix production and supply for paving and rehabilitation works.

03Equipment

Equipment for the work

The machines behind every carriageway we deliver — presented as technical elevations until site photography is added to each frame.

Equipment photography and technical illustrations are presented for capability reference. Fleet photography can be added as the equipment portfolio is documented.

04Road Works

Built layer by layer

Road carpeting is built from the ground up — every layer placed, compacted and finished to specification.

A road that lasts is engineered below the surface. Sub-base and base layers are placed and compacted to grade before the asphalt wearing course is paved hot, rolled and finished — giving the carriageway its strength, drainage and ride quality.
